parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (in `AppServices`) and `PlaycutSelection` (in `app:iOS`) are `type-alias-object` structs with an identical `playcut:Playcut` field and a single differing slot: `artwork:Image?` vs `artwork:UIImage?`. The only structural divergence is the platform image type (`Image` for SwiftUI vs `UIImage` for UIKit), which is a textbook candidate for a single generic struct parameterised on the artwork type. Introducing `PlaycutPresentation<ArtworkImage>` in `AppServices` (the upstream package) with `var artwork: ArtworkImage?` and `var playcut: Playcut` would let the iOS app layer instantiate `PlaycutPresentation<UIImage>` and any SwiftUI layer use `PlaycutPresentation<Image>`, eliminating the duplication without coupling the shared package to a platform-specific image type. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no restraint override is needed.
